title: Apply human-reviewed steering edits with reproducible promotion
description:
## Scope

Generalize scorecard proposal and promotion while preserving the boundary: the agent proposes edits, code validates/applies them, and the fit sets weights and calibration. A scripted analyst must be installed before any agent is parsed; live agents remain explicit.

## Definition of done

Network-free specs prove no paid client is reached, no analyst can write weights or provenance, and rejected/accepted proposals preserve rollback and lineage. Selection/promotion reads development data, never the protected scoreboard.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Apply human-reviewed steering edits with reproducible promotion
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a scripted steering proposal is evaluated with a protected scoreboard
    When code validates the proposal and a human accepts it
    Then only allowed edits are promoted and the agent never sees scoreboard data or sets fitted numbers
```
